evidenceQuotes: The Senior Manager, Quality reports to the MGB AMC Quality Director within the Office of the Chief Medical Officer (OCMO) and is responsible for the success of a broad quality program across the Spaulding Rehabilitation Network (SRN).

The role provides leadership across SRN’s four sites and diverse care settings, including IRF, LTCH, and SNF, with responsibility for quality strategy, performance measurement, and Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI) planning, execution, and governance.

The Senior Manager partners closely with Spaulding executive, clinical, and operational leadership to identify priorities, interpret performance, address emerging risks, and advance improvement strategies.
Success in this role requires strong leadership, sound judgment, clear and concise executive communication, and the ability to operate effectively within a complex, matrixed health system.
The individual must be comfortable working across multiple care settings and adapting as organizational priorities and the scope of the quality portfolio evolve.
